questions.question: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

query_plan.having: SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) = (SELECT MAX(total_consumption) FROM (SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE customers.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4)) AS subquery)
